note: Three TN rows, none added: one size gate, one horse camp, one dispersed boat-in system.

excluded.name: THUNDER ROCK CAMPGROUND
excluded.why: rec.gov notice: 'RV's, trailers, and pop-ups greater than 20 feet in length are NOT allowed at this facility because of maneuverability restrictions.' Catalog pads run to 80 ft; the agency's access limit wins

excluded.name: Station Camp Campground (Big South Fork)
excluded.why: 'also known as Station Camp Horse Camp', tie-stalls on every site. Big South Fork's general campground, Bandy Creek, is already entry 4437

excluded.name: DALE HOLLOW LAKE - PRIMITIVE CAMPING
excluded.why: 70+ primitive sites spread over 620 miles of shoreline, mostly boat-in or tent; the 5 drive-in STANDARD sites are unbookable and state no length, and USACE advises using the developed campgrounds
